events.title: MTV launched
events.blurb: Music Television (MTV) launched on August 1, 1981, with The Buggles' 'Video Killed The Radio Star' as its first video.

angles.name: MTV's big day
angles.copy: Remember when music videos changed everything? Today marks the launch of MTV, forever altering how we consume music.

events.title: Oasis' 'Definitely Maybe' anniversary
events.blurb: Oasis released their iconic debut album 'Definitely Maybe' on August 29, 1994.

angles.name: Definitely Maybe anniversary
angles.copy: Thirty-two years ago today, Oasis dropped 'Definitely Maybe' and changed the sound of British music forever. What's your favourite track?

events.title: Woodstock Festival anniversary
events.blurb: The legendary Woodstock Music & Art Fair took place from August 15-18, 1969.

angles.name: Woodstock anniversary
angles.copy: Peace, love, and three days of music that defined a generation. Today marks the anniversary of the iconic Woodstock Festival.

events.title: Remembering Elvis Presley
events.blurb: The King of Rock and Roll, Elvis Presley, passed away on August 16, 1977.

angles.name: Elvis tribute
angles.copy: Forty-nine years ago today, the music world lost an icon. Remembering the unparalleled legacy of Elvis Presley.

events.title: Remembering Tupac Shakur
events.blurb: Tupac Shakur was shot in Las Vegas on September 7, 1996, and tragically died on September 13, 1996.

angles.name: Tupac tribute
angles.copy: Thirty years on, the impact of Tupac Shakur's music and message continues to resonate. Remembering a true legend.

events.title: Remembering Jimi Hendrix
events.blurb: Legendary guitarist Jimi Hendrix passed away on September 18, 1970.

angles.name: Jimi Hendrix tribute
angles.copy: Fifty-six years ago today, the world lost a guitar visionary. Remembering the incredible artistry of Jimi Hendrix.

events.title: The Beatles' 'Abbey Road' anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles released their iconic album 'Abbey Road' on September 26, 1969.

angles.name: Abbey Road anniversary
angles.copy: The zebra crossing, the songs, the legacy. Today marks an anniversary for The Beatles' 'Abbey Road' – a true masterpiece.

events.title: Chrissie Hynde turns 75
events.blurb: The Pretenders' frontwoman Chrissie Hynde celebrates her 75th birthday today.

angles.name: Chrissie Hynde birthday
angles.copy: Happy 75th birthday to the one and only Chrissie Hynde! A true rock icon and trailblazer.

events.title: Liam Gallagher turns 54
events.blurb: Former Oasis frontman Liam Gallagher celebrates his 54th birthday today.

angles.name: Liam Gallagher birthday
angles.copy: Our Kid is another year older! Happy 54th birthday to the legendary Liam Gallagher. Still absolutely biblical.

events.title: John Lennon's 'Imagine' anniversary
events.blurb: John Lennon's iconic album 'Imagine' was released on September 9, 1971.

angles.name: Imagine anniversary
angles.copy: Fifty-five years since John Lennon released 'Imagine'. A timeless anthem for peace that still resonates today.

events.title: First iPod released
events.blurb: Apple unveiled the first-generation iPod on October 23, 2001, and it was released on November 10, 2001.

angles.name: iPod launch anniversary
angles.copy: Twenty-five years ago, a little device promised '1,000 songs in your pocket' and changed music forever. Happy anniversary to the original iPod.

events.title: James Bond Day
events.blurb: James Bond Day celebrates the release of the first 007 film, 'Dr. No', on October 5, 1962.

angles.name: James Bond Day
angles.copy: Shaken, not stirred. Happy James Bond Day! Celebrating over six decades of the world's most famous secret agent.

events.title: John Lennon would have been 86
events.blurb: Legendary musician John Lennon would have celebrated his 86th birthday today.

angles.name: John Lennon tribute
angles.copy: On what would have been his 86th birthday, we remember the enduring spirit and timeless music of John Lennon.

events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: Comedic icon John Cleese celebrates his 87th birthday today.

angles.name: John Cleese birthday
angles.copy: And now for something completely different... Happy 87th birthday to the brilliant, and very silly, John Cleese!

events.title: The Beatles' 'White Album' anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles released their self-titled double album, commonly known as 'The White Album', on November 22, 1968.

angles.name: White Album anniversary
angles.copy: Fifty-eight years since its release, The Beatles' 'White Album' remains a sprawling, genre-bending masterpiece. What's your top track?
